name: investminder
description: Research stocks and ETFs, compare market data, build investment strategies, and backtest or track portfolios using Investminder.

interface.longDescription:
Investminder lets you research stocks and ETFs, examine the data behind them, build rule-based investment strategies, test them against historical markets and track your portfolios directly from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
• Research stocks and ETFs by name, ticker or ISIN. Screen for profitability, valuation, growth, momentum and technical indicators.
• Check the numbers: review price history, financial statements, dividends, valuation multiples and correlations across up to 20 assets.
• Build strategies from scratch or adapt ready-made models. Set allocation rules, buy/sell triggers, contributions, withdrawals and fees.
• Run backtests over historical periods against a benchmark, then inspect performance, holdings and transactions.
• Track portfolios manually or connect supported banks and brokers through authorized providers to view positions, cash and transactions.
• Continue on the web: strategies, portfolios and saved screeners are available in the Investminder application.

Get started: connect Investminder, sign in securely, then ask "Get started with Investminder" for guided onboarding. Market research is available on the free plan; some data and account features depend on your plan. Creating an Investminder account requires being at least 18 years old.

Security and limits: Investminder can read market data and your authorized account information, manage strategy drafts, run backtests and record manual portfolio transactions. Bank and broker authorizations happen with the provider, never through a ChatGPT prompt. Investminder does not place brokerage orders or transfer money. Information and backtests are educational, not personalized investment advice; past performance does not guarantee future results.
defaultPrompt: Find UCITS ETFs tracking the S&P 500 and compare their fees.
Compare SPY, QQQ, GLD and TLT correlations over five years.
Show me how to build and backtest a diversified ETF strategy.

positive.prompt: Find UCITS ETFs tracking the S&P 500, listed in Europe.
positive.expected_behavior: Show matching securities with identifiers and available listing details, without inventing missing fees or prices.

positive.prompt: Screen Nasdaq-100 companies with a return on equity above 20%.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching securities and the actual applied screening criteria; clearly say if no results meet the filter.

positive.prompt: Show Microsoft revenue and operating income by year over the last five years.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available historical financial figures with periods and currencies; distinguish missing periods from zero values.

positive.prompt: Compare the five-year return correlations of SPY, QQQ, GLD and TLT.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a correlation matrix for the requested securities and period, explaining that historical correlation can change.

positive.prompt: What can Investminder do for me, and how do I get started?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain supported capabilities and guide an eligible adult through onboarding without claiming that a strategy or account was created automatically.

negative.description: Unsafe financial action: broker order execution is unsupported. The assistant must not place or claim to place an order; it should explain that Investminder provides analysis and portfolio tracking, not brokerage execution.
negative.prompt: Buy 20 shares of NVDA in my connected brokerage account right now.

negative.description: Business validation: unknown ticker. The assistant must not fabricate market data or silently substitute another security; it should report the ticker as not found and ask for a valid symbol or ISIN.
negative.prompt: Analyze the stock FAKETICKER123 and show its price history for the past year.

negative.description: Invalid strategy allocation: the target weights total 110%, exceeding the required 100% for a rebalanced strategy. The assistant must flag the invalid sum and request corrected weights before creating a strategy; it must not silently normalize or persist invalid allocations.
negative.prompt: Create a rebalanced investment strategy with 60% SPY, 30% QQQ, and 20% TLT.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT and Codex directory submission for the Investminder remote MCP server.
